title: Ramsar site boundary
description: The lime outline follows the designated Pallikaranai Marsh Ramsar site.
limitation: The designation covers part of the wider wetland landscape.

title: Built-up landscape
description: This label anchors to a mapped building footprint east of the Ramsar site. Amber polygons trace mapped structures in the surrounding city.
limitation: Mapped footprints reflect the source snapshot. Building dates and changes across radar observations are unknown.

title: Okkiyam Maduvu
description: This independently mapped channel runs east from the marsh landscape. Follow the cyan line to see its mapped course.
limitation: The mapped geometry gives the channel location. Current flow and connectivity require separate evidence.

title: Strong radar return
description: The selected pixel has strong displayed HH and HV contributions. Both radar channels return relatively strong signals here.
limitation: Surface type and environmental cause require independent evidence.
